# OpenRarity

> Open source NFT rarity scoring for complete collections. Python reference, TypeScript scorer, and local browser playground.

PyPI 0.7.5 is the released API. This site's ordered inputs, schemas, creator settings,
and TypeScript APIs describe 1.0 development. TypeScript is not published to npm.
Scoring runs locally; there is no hosted scoring HTTP API. Preserve original numeric
JSON text and string token IDs. Rarity does not measure market value.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/agents.md): version selection and scoring steps.
- [API reference](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/api.md): functions, input and result contracts.
- [Python guide](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/python.md): released API and optional fetching.
- [Migration examples](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/migration.md): Python and TypeScript ordered input examples.
- [Scoring specification](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/SPEC.md): normalization, numeric scoring, and tie rules.

- [Local CLI](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/cli.md): JSON/CSV rankings and per-trait explanations.
- [Benchmarks](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/benchmarks.md): reproducible 10k/100k local scoring.

## Data and source

- [Collection schema](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/schemas/collection.schema.json): generated structural input schema.
- [Results schema](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/schemas/results.schema.json): generated serialized result schema.
- [Creator-config schema](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/schemas/creator-config.schema.json): well-formed creator settings.
- [Explanation schema](https://openrarity.github.io/open-rarity/schemas/explanations.schema.json): per-trait contributions and source entries.
- [Repository](https://github.com/OpenRarity/open-rarity): source, fixtures, and contribution instructions in AGENTS.md.
- [Releases](https://github.com/OpenRarity/open-rarity/releases): published versions and release notes.
